svg.text: sqlite-history-json: repair change history after schema drift
Tables tracked with sqlite-history-json were altered: columns added, renamed and dropped, and whole tables renamed. Restore now returns NULLs or fails, yet the
upgrade command reports nothing to do. The agent fixes the library so one upgrade run brings every history back in line with the current schema.
